1.title: A Democratic Socialist Seeks New Voters in an Unlikely Place: Fox News
1.summary: Gustavo Gordillo, a leader of the New York D.S.A., wants to reach new voters. But in interviews with conservative media, the backlash can be sharp.

2.title: Obama and Abdul El-Sayed Spoke to Discuss Unity After Michigan Senate Primary
2.summary: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed’s call with the former president comes as he tries to win over wary Democrats in Michigan’s high-stakes Senate race.

3.title: Michigan Senate Candidate, a Former Trump Critic, Shifts Toward Election Skepticism
3.summary: Mike Rogers, the Republican nominee, has suggested that further scrutiny of the 2020 election was warranted and that voting irregularities sank his first Senate bid two years ago.

4.title: Iran, Holding Firm to Hormuz, Pushes for Return to June MOU
4.summary: The Strait of Hormuz is Iran’s best leverage to get Washington to release Iran’s frozen assets, lift economic sanctions and end its naval blockade.

5.title: Syria Agrees to Reorganized Russian Military Presence
5.summary: After more than a year and a half of negotiations, Syria and Russia have agreed on new parameters of Russia’s military presence in Syria. Syria said it opens the way for a new phase in relations.

6.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
6.summary: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.
